hero.headline: Omugwo on Your Terms
hero.subheadline: Keep the Help, Skip the War - A Three-Zone Agreement for Traditional Postpartum Support
hero.body: The helper arrives with strong practices - substances on the cord, herb water for baby, baby handed over at all hours, visitors flooding in - while hospital instructions said otherwise and the mother is too exhausted and polite to push back. She cannot tell which traditions are harmless gold versus documented infection/danger risks, cannot refuse without triggering family war, and is sliding from mother to furniture in her own home. Grandma keeps her proud role, doctor-backed rules protect the baby on paper, and you keep your sleep, your bond and the peace.

before_state.label: Sound familiar?
before_state.headline: It is not that you are failing. The family dynamic just has no system.
paragraphs: Right now hinting instead of deciding, complying then resenting, arguing science at elders, and partner absent from boundary enforcement - and the people who matter most (mother, grandmother/mother-in-law, partner, and visitors) are all pulling in different directions.
On top of that, baby routines overridden, substances reaching the stump/baby, and mother sidelined from care.
It feels like boiling resentment, maternal guilt both directions, and dread of helper's footsteps.
The cost: infection risks introduced, mother's sleep blocks lost, and household tension escalating.
before_state.punch: This is not a personal failing. It is a system gap - and Omugwo on Your Terms closes it.

who_for.label: Fit check
who_for.headline: Read both sides before you buy.
who_for.intro: This system is built for a specific situation. If that is not you, it will not help - and we would rather tell you now.
for_items: New mother receiving traditional postpartum help (omugwo) from her mother or mother-in-law who loves the baby fiercely but runs the household and baby-care by her own pre-1990s rules

The helper arrives with strong practices - substances on the cord, herb water for baby, baby handed over at all hours, visitors flooding in - while hospital instructions said otherwise and the mother is too exhausted and polite to push back
Tried hinting and silent resistance; helper doubled down or got hurt; partner stayed neutral to keep peace
who_for.not_for_label: This is NOT for you if
not_for_items: Coordinates household roles and communication ONLY. Never adjudicates clinical questions (routes to clinician), never treats mood disorders (routes via crisis lines), never overrides baby's doctor.

If any red flag is present (any substance reached cord stump or baby's mouth; baby fed anything besides milk; unsafe sleep positioning imposed), this is not a home system - seek professional care first.
who_for.note: Coordinates household roles and communication ONLY.

promise.label: What we promise - and what we don't
promise.headline: A system. Not a guarantee.
promise.we_do: Grandma keeps her proud role, doctor-backed rules protect the baby on paper, and you keep your sleep, your bond and the peace. A written three-zone agreement (hers/together/doctor-backed) that gives grandma proud ownership of real work, protects medical non-negotiables as the DOCTOR'S rules not hers, and preserves both the tradition and the mother.
promise.we_do_not: We do not promise: cannot erase cultural friction entirely, requires partner follow-through, and not a treatment for clinical mood disorders. This is an educational system, not medical, clinical, or mental-health care.
promise.evidence_label: Educational content informed by sourced research and clinical guidance. It is not a substitute for medical, clinical, or mental-health assessment.
